text_block_list.text:
One day, several boxes of fan mail arrive
at the
academy, all addressed to
Симболи Рудольф.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I'm... at a loss for words.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
We have some time today before
training, I
believe.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Would you mind if I read through these
in the
meantime?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I appreciate it. These letters deserve my
full
attention.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
As we Umamusume race in the Twinkle
Series, we
inspire dreams in the hearts of
the fans who watch
us.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
And in turn, their support becomes the
wind at
our back, urging us ever onward
in pursuit of our
own dreams.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: That cycle is something I cherish dearly.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I wish to carry all my fans' support with
me as I
move forward.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
To me, that is part of being an
Umamusume.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
From the earnestness with which Symboli
Rudolf
sits down to read, it's clear that
she truly
treasures her fans.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
